pages.text:
**Fits:** [[locomotive_cart]], motorboats.

A 100,000 FE battery: the engine runs only on it, using 20 FE per tick.

**Fuel charges the battery** whenever it isn't full, so fuel lasts as long as before. Once full, it stops lighting fuel.

**Charging:** a locomotive draws from a [[charging_rail]], or an energy block under the rail. A motorboat draws from energy blocks right next to it, like a [[heat_turbine|turbine]] on a dock.

A red bar on the inventory screen shows the charge.
